name: @backend/vm-ops-api
description: The bearer-gated control surface of the VM, in Rust (core/, rs/). Its integration suite is integration/, run against this service's binary; its flow tests drive the router in-process (rs/tests/flow.rs).

scripts.test:integration: D="$PWD/../../.agents/tmp/test-output/vm-ops-api/test-integration" && rm -rf "$D" && cargo build --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p vm-ops-api-rs --target-dir ../target && VM_OPS_API_CMD="$PWD/../target/debug/vm-ops-api-rs" WF_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR="$D" cargo test --locked --manifest-path integration/Cargo.toml --target-dir ../target
